title: sdr daily scratchpad - carter nguyen - 2026-03-18
content:
Morning plan (3/18) - Focus block 9:00-11:30: outbound calls + voicemails (UK/EMEA list)
- Quick 15m sync w/ Maya at 11:45 to confirm demos for next week
- Afternoon: handle inbound replies + schedule next-step meetings

Top priorities
1) Book demo with BrightGrid (VP Eng - Hannah Cole) - urgent, procurement Q2
2) Follow up with AtlasHealth AE intro (demo requested 3/16)
3) Re-engage FintechCo (no answer since pricing sent)

Call list (priority order)
- BrightGrid — Hannah Cole (VP Eng) — call 9:15am GMT, dial +44 20 7xx xxxx, note: lead from webinar, interested in Dedicated for latency/SLA. Pre-call: mention low-latency LLM routing and customer ref (AcmeSoft).
- AtlasHealth — Priya Rao (Head of ML Ops) — voicemail left 9:45am PST, follow-up email template below. Interested in private deployment + KMS.
- FintechCo — Marco Ruiz (CTO) — sent pricing 3/10, no reply. Try alternative contact: Sofia (Platform lead).
- RetailX — Samir Patel (Product) — scheduled intro 3/19 10am PT (confirm).
- GreenLogistics — Tomasz Wroblewski — cold call attempt, leave short value prop: cost-per-token & batching savings for high-throughput routing.

Follow-up email templates (short)
- After voicemail: "Hi {First}, quick voicemail — happy to jump on a 20m call this week to walk through how Redwood can reduce per-token cost by ~30% w/ caching + batching. Are you free Wed/Thu? — Carter"
- Pricing nudges: "Hi {First}, sharing the numbers again and a brief comparison to standard cloud endpoints. If helpful, can run a 30m cost-latency projection for your 2k qps workload. When works?"

Notes / talk tracks (short bullets)
- Can highlight: Dedicated pools, autoscale bursts, model pinning for consistent outputs.
- Common objection: "We manage our own models" => pivot to ops cost + observability + SLAs.
- For regulated customers: mention Private (VPC + KMS + audit logs) and case study (FinReg bank).

Pipeline quick statuses
- BrightGrid (working) — demo requested, high close chance if we show latency numbers. Needs legal review (procurement). Action: secure 1 internal latency trace + sample dashboard by EOD.
- AtlasHealth (follow) — demo scheduled tentatively next week. Action: prep HIPAA notes + private deployment checklist.
- FintechCo (stalled) — drop to nurture after 2 more touches. Action: send short pricing summary + ask for decision timeline.

Tasks / TODO (today)
- [ ] Prep BrightGrid demo artifacts (latency trace + cost slide) — deliver to Alex by 4pm PT
- [ ] Send follow-up email to Marco + copy CFO thread if no reply by Friday
- [ ] Update Confluence page with HIPAA checklist (link in linked_artifacts) — quick pass
- [ ] Log call outcomes in Salesforce after each call (include notes + next step)

Reminders / personal notes
- Keep voicemails <20s and include 2 metrics: latency improvement + cost saving
- Use Slack template for legal asks: #legal-requests -> tag Alex M and attach basic MSA outline
- Block Wed 2-3pm for trial onboarding review with SEs if BrightGrid confirms

Open questions / follow-ups to ask internally
- Can infra team provide a 1-2 minute clip showing model routing fallbacks for demos? (ask @Maya)
- Any new price changes effective Apr 1 I should be aware of? (check pricing-docs on Confluence)

End-of-day quick metrics to capture
- #calls made / voicemails / replies / meetings booked
- Note 3 biggest wins and 2 blockers for tomorrow

Scratch notes (raw)
- Heard back from AcmeSoft reference — SE said 18ms median, full dashboard share ok. Good to have in deck.
- Reminder: update email snippets with EMEA time zones and remove US-only examples.

--- Last modified by Carter Nguyen on 2026-03-18.
